args.sql:
SELECT p.prodcode, COUNT(DISTINCT pb.store_cond) as num_conditions
FROM products p 
JOIN productbatches pb ON p.prodcode = pb.prodlink 
WHERE p.prodcat = 'Biologics'
GROUP BY p.prodcode
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pb.store_cond) > 1
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_bio_batches,
  SUM(CASE WHEN pb.store_cond = '-70°C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as very_low_temp_batches,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN pb.store_cond = '-70°C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) as percent_very_low
FROM products p 
JOIN productbatches pb ON p.prodcode = pb.prodlink 
WHERE p.prodcat = 'Biologics';

SELECT pb.store_cond, COUNT(*) as cnt
FROM products p 
JOIN productbatches pb ON p.prodcode = pb.prodlink 
WHERE p.prodcat = 'Biologics'
GROUP BY pb.store_cond;

SELECT 
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN pb.store_cond = '-70°C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS proportion_percent
FROM products p 
JOIN productbatches pb ON p.prodcode = pb.prodlink 
WHERE p.prodcat = 'Biologics';
